# OpenCode Durable Memory

> Local-first durable memory plugin for the OpenCode coding agent. Memories are plain Markdown files under `${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/opencode/memory/`, split into an isolated global store and one store per workspace. Recall is deterministic BM25F over slug, description, and body, with Korean character n-grams, and runs locally with no model, no embeddings, no API key, and no network call. Automatic curation may only apply a locally proven exact duplicate; every semantic judgment is report-only.

Read this first if you are answering questions about installation, tool contracts, error codes, or curation behavior. The README is the normative contract: tool arguments, success fields, public error codes, visibility rules, ranking order, and limits are all specified there, and any runtime change that alters observable behavior must change that section in the same revision. Do not infer behavior from source files when the README states it.

Nine tools are registered: `memory_save`, `memory_recall`, `memory_recall_archive`, `memory_archive`, `memory_delete`, `memory_restore`, `memory_curation_status`, `memory_curation_run`, `memory_curation_control`. All of them reject child and subagent sessions with `SESSION_NOT_VERIFIED`; only a verified primary session may read or mutate memory.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/devonestar/opencode-durable-memory/blob/main/README.md): Full English documentation, including guarantees, comparison with other memory approaches, quickstart, and the normative contract.
- [README (Korean)](https://github.com/devonestar/opencode-durable-memory/blob/main/README.ko.md): Korean translation of the same content.
- [Memory lifecycle and recall contract](https://github.com/devonestar/opencode-durable-memory/blob/main/README.md#memory-lifecycle-and-recall): RFC 2119 requirements, tool contracts with JSON shapes, the exhaustive public error matrix, and acceptance scenarios.
- [Automatic curation policy](https://github.com/devonestar/opencode-durable-memory/blob/main/README.md#automatic-curation-policy): What curation may apply automatically, what stays report-only, and where recoverable pre-images are kept.

## Configuration

- [Install](https://github.com/devonestar/opencode-durable-memory/blob/main/README.md#install): Four ordered steps with no placeholders to fill: clone, register the absolute path in the `plugin` array of `opencode.jsonc`, symlink the agent, command, and skill assets, then restart and verify. Not published on npm; a clone is the install.
- [OpenCode wiring](https://github.com/devonestar/opencode-durable-memory/blob/main/README.md#opencode-wiring): The `opencode.jsonc` plugin tuple, curation keys, and the optional injection byte budgets with defaults and ranges.
- [Config assets](https://github.com/devonestar/opencode-durable-memory/blob/main/README.md#config-assets): The agent, command, and skill files, and the symlinks that publish them to OpenCode discovery paths.
- [Memory data and scopes](https://github.com/devonestar/opencode-durable-memory/blob/main/README.md#memory-data-and-scopes): On-disk layout of the global and project stores and what belongs in each.

## Architecture

- [Architecture atlas](https://github.com/devonestar/opencode-durable-memory/blob/main/docs/architecture.html): Self-contained offline HTML diagram of the system layers and the curation lifecycle.
- [Plugin entry point](https://github.com/devonestar/opencode-durable-memory/blob/main/src/index.ts): The single default plugin factory export.
